# externs-phpstubs

> Read-only Kotlin registry of PHP built-in declarations as commons-phpmodels entries, each with its extension provenance, plus psalm's taint data and a hand-maintained rules set as mountable commons-phpmodels document sets.

`PhpStubs` is the singleton entry point. Lookup names go through the commons-phpmodels subject creators: functions, classes, and methods fold case and drop a leading `\`; constants keep their case unless `caseSensitive = false`.

## Instructions for Agents

- Call `PhpStubs.findFunction(name)` for `StubEntry<FunctionSubject>?`, `findClass(name)` for `StubEntry<ClassSubject>?`.
- Call `PhpStubs.findMethod(name, owner?)` for `StubEntry<MethodSubject>?`; the entry's `subject` carries `owner` and `name`.
- Call `PhpStubs.findConstant(name, caseSensitive?)` for `StubEntry<ConstantSubject>?`, `findClassConstant(name, owner?, caseSensitive?)` for `StubEntry<ClassConstantSubject>?`.
- `StubEntry` holds `subject`, `model: SubjectModel` (commons-phpmodels), and `extension`. Read signatures through the typed accessors `callableSignature`, `classSignature`, `typedSignature`, `propertySignature`.
- A name containing `::`, `$`, whitespace, or nothing raises `IllegalArgumentException`; an unknown name returns `null`.
- Declared flows are `entry.model.body.propagation`; `null` means no flow is declared.
- Taint sources, sinks, and sanitizers are NOT registry entries. They ship as the `taint/` document set in psalm's names: load it with `DocumentSetLoader.load(StubResources.opener(StubResources.TAINT), context, mapping)`.
- Assertions beyond psalm's (Argus sinks, `echo`, `escapeshellarg`, `$_SERVER`, `getenv`, ...) are the `rules/` set: load it with `DocumentSetLoader.load(StubResources.opener(StubResources.RULES), taintVocabulary)` or under the same mapping as `taint/` extended by `xpath` and `external`; mount it after `taint/`.
- `StubResources.MODELS`, `StubResources.TAINT`, and `StubResources.RULES` are the classpath roots; `StubResources.opener(root)` yields the `ResourceOpener` the set loader needs.

## API Reference

- [Stubs API](llms/stubs.md): `PhpStubs`, `StubEntry`, `StubRegistry`, `StubLoader`.
